mistake_reason: At Step 7, WebSurfer was explicitly instructed to return strict JSON only but responded with conversational preface text and malformed JSON (single quotes instead of double quotes and a trailing comma). This formatting error (FM-4.4) prevented the parser from extracting the writer reliably. The team then relied on a heuristic normalization that incorrectly changed "Levin" to "Levine," leading to the wrong final answer.
